title: PayPal AI Hackathon: Build What's Next with PayPal and AI
description: PayPal's global online hackathon on Devpost. Build or update an app, agent or automation that meaningfully uses both the PayPal developer platform (free sandbox) and an AI tool, model or platform. No tracks or prescribed problems. $67,500 in cash prizes.
reward: $67,500 in prizes, paid in cash: $12,000 first, $8,000 second, $5,000 third, $5,000 special awards (including Best Use of Agentic Commerce) and sponsor prizes
summary: $67,500 in prizes · closes Nov 12, 12:00 PM PT

eligibility.note: meaningfully uses a PayPal API, SDK or developer capability together with an AI model, tool or platform
a public code repo with a visible open source license

setup: join the hackathon with a Devpost account
sign up for a PayPal Developer account (sandbox)
each_time: a public demo video under 3 minutes
a public repo with an open source license
rules: Submit on Devpost by Thursday, November 12, 2026 at 12:00 PM Pacific Time.
The project must meaningfully use both PayPal (at least one PayPal technology, API, SDK, product or developer capability) and AI.
New or existing projects: an existing project must have been significantly updated after October 1, 2026, and you must explain how.
Judges must be able to run or interact with a working build: give complete setup instructions in the repo or a hosted demo URL. Mockups and non-functional demos do not qualify.
The code repository must be public on GitHub, GitLab or Bitbucket, with all source code and a visible open source license.
Open to individuals and teams above the legal age of majority, all countries except standard exceptions.
Judging runs December 1 to 15, 2026; winners are announced on or around December 21, 2026.
